text: Simple illustration of a hyper-realistic 8K digital painting, masterpiece quality. A profound scene in a cluttered, dark art studio. On the left, an ethereal, glowing female figure (representing the AI/Muse) stands, her form subtly translucent and crowned with an incandescent halo. On the right, a male artist is absorbed in painting on an easel, illuminated by a localized, warm desk lamp. The environment is packed with highly detailed canvases, scattered paint brushes, and intricate shelving. The lighting is dramatic and moody, utilizing extreme shadows (deep blacks). Focus on the interplay between the cool, electric cyan/blue ambient light and the warm, saturated amber spotlight. High fidelity textures on the robes and the rough wood of the studio. Detailed atmospheric fog. Cinematic depth of field.
